steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Ugh... What happened?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You're awake!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I'm begging you man, at least holler the next time something like this happens, alright? Pull another stunt like that, and I won't be able to save you!

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: How's the situation? That woman's monsters... Have they all been burned away yet?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I can't say for sure, but probably. I mean, I've only seen the full extent of Mon3tr's firepower in tactical records before.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: ...Burn it. Burn it all.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Gran Faro is already a thing of the past. Just burn it all down.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Mr. Thiago, you—

steps.name: Burnt Cultist
steps.text: Ahh, traitor! And you, Iberian! I've caught your scents. This is where you're hiding!

steps.name: Burnt Cultist
steps.text: You came at just the right time. Yes, yes, just the right time—!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: —What are you?!

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Hmph. Already blind and beyond recognition. Serves him right for pleasuring himself with that monster!

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Serves you right! You hear me?!

steps.name: Burnt Cultist
steps.text: Serves me right? Hah, it sure does, Thiago. For choosing to trust a man blinded by hatred, for ever having delusions that people like you could be saved. Serves me right, indeed.

steps.name: Burnt Cultist
steps.text: But now, everything... is... different. (Bones grind and crunch together)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: –-Sea Terrors? But when?!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Thiago, don't get too close! Something's wrong with this guy!

steps.name: Burnt Cultist
steps.text: Iberia must be destroyed! We will annihilate this country. This land will become the ocean's cradle. The waves shall swallow the clouds, and scores of mountains will dissolve without a sound—

steps.name: Burnt Cultist
steps.text: We shall— all— become— one!!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Watch out! Thiago!

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Guh?! *cough*—!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Thiago! Tch, he's already transforming into a monster! Just like in the reports from Sal Viento!

steps.name: Burnt Cultist
steps.text: I'll start with you, traitor.

steps.name: Burnt Cultist
steps.text: For the perpetuation of life eternal, Iberia... is... meaningless!
Meaningless, you say?

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Are you calling for me by name, heretic?

steps.name: Burnt Cultist
steps.text: ...High Inquisitor, you made it just in time.

steps.name: Burnt Cultist
steps.text: Go ahead and pray. We will prove to you that your god is meaningless too. You will watch as Iberia sinks into the abyss.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: That will never happen.

steps.name: Burnt Cultist
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: My name is... Carmen I Iberia. When the nine saints gave themselves this false title, they abandoned their own names—and with it, their beliefs.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: We are immolated by lies. Nobody knows this better than us. God never offered salvation to Iberia. We must become our own gods.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: On behalf of the Inquisition, I hereby read your sentence, heretic.
What is this heaviness I feel?
My body has already been accepted by my kin. My life has already received sublimation.
So why? Why am I unable to take my eyes off his lantern?
Self-preservation? Yes, all Inquisitors are quite powerful, so I am on guard.

steps.name: Burnt Cultist
steps.text: You may kill me, but you cannot kill our kind. Kill our kind, and the sea will die. When the sea dies, the land will die with it.

steps.name: Burnt Cultist
steps.text: You will all eventually drown in the rising tide of evolution. You will not live to see this land's future! This era is bloated and discordant, and we are all but livestock trapped in cages!

steps.name: Burnt Cultist
steps.text: I will put you and your Inquisition—
He looks at his body in disbelief. A beautiful cross-section.
Since their invasion of Gran Faro began, the old Inquisitor who sat at the town's chapel has never lifted his hand even once.
He never wielded his sword, or drew his handcannon. He used only his lantern and his Arts, befitting someone as ancient as him.
Yes, ancient. He is very old. A span of time far too great for the ordinary life to endure.

steps.name: Burnt Cultist
steps.text: Land-crawling... livestock... How did you...?

steps.name: Burnt Cultist
steps.text: At least I was... able to... buy...

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: You've accomplished nothing.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: A brand new lifeform, yet unable to take the life of even this old Iberian. What do you have to be proud of?

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Look at me, heretic.

steps.name: Burnt Cultist
steps.text: You... *cough*, *cough*... Damn you!

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: You were once human too. But you narrow-mindedly misjudged the potential of your own race.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: For tens of thousands of years, this is how we have won our wars. Nature selects, life adapts.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: You, and your pathetic ideas, will be buried in Iberia. Before your last breath, be sure to pass on our thunderous roar to your kin.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: 'The sea faces an ancient enemy called civilization, one you stand no chance of overcoming.'

steps.name: Burnt Cultist
steps.text: You... Gurk... You... you understand nothing...

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: How's he doing?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I've been trying everything I could this whole time! But the wound's too deep!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: If only Dr. Kal'tsit were here. He needs medical attention immediately, sir! Where is she?

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Waiting in the chapel.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: I should make this clear, member of Rhodes Island. His treason is indefensible, and he must answer for his crimes.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Knowingly sheltering the Church of the Deep's cultists has caused the Inquisition to lose a prime opportunity. It has also placed Dario and countless of our brothers in the Penal Battalion in grave peril.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: ...Tch, old fool.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: How old are you anyway? A hundred? How do you... ugh... still pretend to have so much energy?

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: It is my duty.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: So you must... *cough*, *cough*... urgh... know all sorts of things...

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Tell me, Inquisitor. Tell me the truth, you wretched executioner...

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Why would you... urgh... destroy a band of people... hoping to rebuild... their home?

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: All of you... All of you...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Don't speak, Thiago! I can't stop the bleeding!

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Ha... Hah... No, I must ask.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: All of you, the Inquisition! Those Ægir you took from Gran Faro... were there really any cultists among them?

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Tell me... Did you really, out of... *cough*, paranoia... nothing more than a laughable paranoia... kill all those good people?

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Ordinary citizens have no right to know the Inquisition's secrets.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: You bastard...!

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Knowing the truth will not help you cling onto your fading life, Thiago.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: No, no no no... I'm begging you... I'm begging you... I'm going to die, and you still won't tell me the truth...

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: At least... Marin... Tell me...

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: The files on Gran Faro's Ægir have been sealed. I am unable to disclose anything to a civilian.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: ...No... *cough*, *cough*... Gah...

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: I... Curse you. I swear, I'll never forgive you!

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Iberia... Ibe... will...
His malediction never leaves his mouth.
Old Thiago looks at the dim, damp ceiling, where a drop of water is about to fall from the wooden beams.
Drip.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: He’s gone.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: So, what's the truth?

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: I don't see how this has anything to do with you either, member of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Return to Kal'tsit. We've lost too much time, and the Eye of Iberia will likely fall.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Please. Tell me.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: As a member of Rhodes Island, I also wish to cooperate with the Inquisition. But before that, I'm an Iberian.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I didn't know Thiago for very long. But I just realized... he would never curse Iberia. Because he truly saw this place as his home.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: But after realizing that, that's all the more reason I can't just...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Lord Carmen, after witnessing so many tragedies in my homeland, surely you can't just... tell me to turn a blind eye to it all.
Carmen glances over at the aged laborer resting in Elysium's arms. His eyes betray a slightly different emotion.
After a moment of silence, he speaks.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Roughly a hundred thirty Ægir were taken from Gran Faro, and of them, about half had ties with the Church of the Deep. Even some members of the Penal Battalion formerly stationed in the town were revealed to be traitors.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: They stole a large amount of information on Iberia's Seafaring Era, obstructed the Inquisition, and were plotting from the very beginning to turn Gran Faro into a nexus for the sea's invasion of the land.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Leading them was a female bishop, an Ægir Islander. A woman the people called 'Marin.'

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Now, give him his burial.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Strong. Work together, and you are strong enough to lead our kind.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: But, you do not plan to do this. This puzzles me.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Our kind, how will you treat them?

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Willpower, begets all. Any chasm, can be crossed.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Our environment, complete and pure. Impurities, are not needed.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: About parents, I am trying to find an answer. Yet the question, is not clear. I cannot ask yet.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: (Sound of bones grinding and rubbing)

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Do all of the sea's infants learn to talk as quickly as you?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: What's wrong, Mister Captain? Has your loneliness finally compelled you to seek companionship with talking Seaborns?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You know, every wound on its body has been MY handiwork so far.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: *Spit*.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: It's still alive and kicking. We're just getting to the good part.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: ...Fighting, is meaningless.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Leaving, is the correct choice.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Ugh, get back here!

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: It tore through the wall and fled. Why did the Iberians have to make this ship so complex anyway?

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: I won't allow it to continue trashing my ship. Garcia!

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: That's cheating, you know~

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: How do you think we managed to keep this ship from getting riddled with holes and sinking, while surrounded by monsters for all these years? Relying solely on Breogan's technology?

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: We systematically kill the ones threatening enough to cause damage. Then, little by little, the survivors slowly sew up the scars they left behind.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: This one can be considered intelligent, as far they go, but it's by no means the strongest.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: I'm not in the mood to play games with you anymore, so this farce ends here. Kill it now, before it does something we can't undo.
The fleeing Seaborn easily tears through the ship's walls. It can smell its kin as well as the ocean just outside this strange box.
It is hurt. It needs healing. It needs nourishment. It needs time. The scaleless kin had bought it a chance to breathe, but far from enough time.
Many preparations are yet to be completed.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: What?! A Seaborn!
The Seaborn does not speak.
Because it faces something that is not its kin. Not kin that speaks. Not kin without scales.
In which case, the small, fragile creature struggling before its eyes is just an ordinary lifeform. Just another part of the Cycle.
It should be consumed.
After coming to this conclusion, the Seaborn almost immediately lashes out at Irene with tooth and claw.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: (So fast! Its body is different from before?!)

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: It's so tough?!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: (Merda— I can't dodge it this time—)

steps.name: Chief Mate
steps.text: (Roars)

steps.name: Chief Mate
steps.text: (Eldritch noises) Stand... up... and run...

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: You... You can talk?! In Iberian?

steps.name: Chief Mate
steps.text: (Eldritch noises) I... save you. Don't let... him know.

steps.name: Chief Mate
steps.text: (Eldritch noises) Don't let... Alfonso... know I'm... still human.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Language, you also know it.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Efficiency, relatively low. Not enough information, not enough time. If necessary, I will complete it.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Kindred, you have formed your own group. And your offspring, consume one another.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: You, are incomplete.

steps.name: Chief Mate
steps.text: (Eldritch noises) Alfonso... cannot... get here fast.

steps.name: Chief Mate
steps.text: (Eldritch noises) You... run.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Kindred, no point in nurturing.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Flesh and blood, donate to us.

steps.name: Chief Mate
steps.text: (Howling) —!
Still attempting to spit out vestiges of human speech, the chief mate is punctured by the Seaborn's fangs.
It neither underestimates its enemy nor is distracted by Irene's presence. The Seaborn's motions have clearly evolved.

steps.name: Chief Mate
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Chief Mate
steps.text: Alfonso... Hurry... Hurry...

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: (I can't even pierce its carapace!)

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: (At this rate, I...)
Irene. You know where this is.
Yes! It's the Inquisition's—
Underground. Where every High Inquisitor has seen the truth.
The truth...
Consider this one thing, Irene. What is the Inquisition fighting for?
For Iberia's purity and virtue, for the sanctity of our Laws and Scriptures.

But what if the concept of truth as seen by the people is only superficial? What if the Law has no reach, the Scriptures fail to prophesize, and the morality that governs all things amounts to naught? How will you pass down judgment then?
I... will judge based on my own standards.
Even if it means casting aside the distinction between good and evil that you've always adhered to?
Of course!
That is easier said than done, Irene. There's no point trying to teach from my example, and I'm not as partial towards words as you are.
Maestro...
But.

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: There will come a day when your enemies will force you to cast aside everything you've ever known. Your faith, your morals, your ethics. Everything will be ravaged, desecrated, rendered null and void.

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: When that happens, if you can manage to rebuild your inner faith, whatever it may be, then that will form the foundation to help you defeat those enemies.

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: Before seeing the truth, before experiencing a crueler history, everything that we do is empty, with no basis in reality.

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: I won't tell you how you should act going forward. But when that time comes, I want you to remember my words, Irene.

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: You must become Iberia's last line of defense.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Survival, is not actually your goal. Perhaps, you can become something greater.
Irene raises her handcannon.
A second cavity suddenly appears in the Seaborn's adamantine body, as a torrential flow of heat melts through its sturdy, unusual walls.
The surging temperature turns the surroundings into a sea of fire. The chief mate sobs and retreats to the side, staring blankly at the scene before its eyes.
The Seaborn has never been enveloped by such Arts before. It feels a sense of being overwhelmed, but quickly adapts.
However, the Inquisitor's barrage will not cease until the flames of her lantern sputter out.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Release the chief mate, you monster. And get a good whiff of the scent of Originium.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: You have not sinned in any way. The Holy Scriptures do not even mention your existence.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Right now it is only I, as an Iberian, who is handing down this verdict.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: The scourge of the seas must be wiped out. You have no right to live.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: In the name of Iberia.
